layer_cascade_hypotheses.cdn_dns: a failure could degrade reachability of many web properties that front through the provider; which ones is unknown without evidence
layer_cascade_hypotheses.sms_voice: a failure could delay one-time passcodes or customer notifications sent through the provider; which senders is unknown without evidence
layer_cascade_hypotheses.cloud: a regional failure could affect workloads hosted in that region; tenants are not identifiable from status text
layer_cascade_hypotheses.saas: a failure could interrupt the business process run on that platform; customers are not identifiable from status text
layer_cascade_hypotheses.identity: a failure could block sign-in to dependent applications
layer_cascade_hypotheses.endpoint_security: a faulty update could affect hosts running the agent
layer_cascade_hypotheses.network_carrier: a failure could affect services carried on that network, including emergency calls where applicable
layer_cascade_hypotheses.payments_rail: a failure could delay settlement or payments for participants
layer_cascade_hypotheses.energy_market_system: market-system notices are signals about market conditions, not dependencies
layer_cascade_hypotheses.network_security: a vulnerability could affect organisations running the product; exposure is not identifiable from advisories
layer_cascade_hypotheses.other: no generic cascade statement; needs a provider-specific evidence review
